# Vendored third-party code

* `ocsort/` — from [Deep-OC-SORT](https://github.com/GerardMaggiolino/Deep-OC-SORT)
  (`trackers/ocsort_tracker/`): Kalman box tracker and OC-SORT association. The Kalman
  filter derives from [filterpy](https://github.com/rlabbe/filterpy) (MIT,
  Copyright 2014-2018 Roger R. Labbe Jr.).

Vendored unmodified except for import-path fixes, so the repository runs out of the box.
The original upstream licenses apply to this directory; see `../../NOTICE`.
